# Spring Cleaning Challenge 2024

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- May 2, 2024
- 12 min read

Updated: Jul 29, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f3b20e2799d84574b22d5866eefcdfc5~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __SugarBombsRADS__

The Spring Cleaning Challenge is a limited-time event in Fallout 76.

On the 7th of May 2024 at 12pm EST (Atom Shop changeover), you will be able to claim the Abraxo Pip-Boy skin for free from the Atom Shop.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_068544ea408b437a9f56cb242011e6a8~mv2.png)

You will need to apply this skin to your Pip-Boy and complete a set number of challenges to unlock limited-time rewards.

__FAQ__

**Can we re-roll the challenges?**

No.

**What happens if I don't complete 4 out of 5 challenges each week?**

You are out of luck and won't be able to unlock the end reward. Sorry.

**Can I complete these challenges on a custom server?**

No.

**Can I complete these challenges on a private server, by myself, if I create a public team?**

Yes.

**Can I complete these challenges in one day?**

It is unsure at this stage, but all the challenges for the week will likely be released on the first day, allowing you a week to complete them.

**Can I wear Power Armour while completing these challenges?**

No. You must climb out of your Power Armour and collect the items. The weapon challenges are the only exception, providing the challenge does not state that you need to have the pip-boy skin equipped.

__Daily Challenges and Rewards__

__Week 1__

**Spring Cleaning: Collect 5 Abraxo Cleaners with the Abraxo Pip-Boy Skin equipped.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_23b5fc9a84e24ed3959a2ba255b74209~mv2.jpg)

**Locations:**

__Vault 51__ - 6

4 can be found in the Laundry

1 can be found in the Laundry in the Overseer's Office

1 can be found on top of the locker, in the locker room, off the Gym.

**Atlantic City** - Casino Quarter - Travel to District - The Neapolitan Casino - 6 can be found on the shelves in the Laundry, in the basement. 

**Whitesprings** - Artisan's Way - 2 can be found in crates on the ground, near the small blue car.

**Whitesprings** - Artisan's Way - The first apartment near the small blue car, 2 can be found in a crate by the door. 

**Whitesprings** - Golf Club - 3 can be found on the shelf, out the back of the Golf Club, near the Golf Carts.

**Whitesprings** - The Whitesprings North Entrance - 6

From the fast travel point, turn North and run towards the white brick wall. Jump the wall and enter the building in front of you.

4 can be found in the room marked "Laundry". Check the crates and the floor.

2 can be found in the male toilets.

**Orwell Bomb Shelter (Orwell Orchards)** - 6 

2 can be found on the bar, in the same room as the pool.

2 can be found on the metal shelf near the washer and dryer in the room with the leaking generator.

2 can be found on the metal shelf, in the locked room off the kitchen. You can fall through the door to gain access.

**Reward**

Scout's Banner

**Spring Cleaning: Collect 3 Brooms with the Abraxo Pip-Boy Skin equipped.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9452ded3c49a458f97fdb264dae28626~mv2.jpg)

**Locations:**

**Enclave Research Facility (Transmission Station 1AT-U03)** - 18

Just wander around and you will find them easy enough.

**Bolton Greens** - 4

1 can be found in the Lobby near the front desk.

1 can be found in the Kitchen, against the wall.

1 can be found in the Bathroom upstairs

1 can be found in the locked room off the kitchen, in the corner, near the filing cabinets

**Camp McClintock** - 3

1 can be found in a wooden crate in the front foyer, leaning against the desk.

1 can be found in the second room, in the Patriotism Training shed behind the main building.

1 can be found in the sleeping quarters (South of the main building), in the second shed, leaning against the back wall.

**Whitesprings (The Whitesprings North Entrance/Exterior)** - 4

From the fast travel point, turn North and run towards the white brick wall. Jump the wall and enter the building in front of you.

1 can be found in the North corner of the room marked "Storage".

1 can be found leaning against the East wall, next to the Armour bench, in the room marked "Workshop".

1 can be found outside, leaning against the white brick wall. Exit the Western door of the building and turn left. Follow the path between the building and the white brick wall and you will see the broom on your right.

1 can be found in the carpark near the dumpster. Re-enter the building, go into the room marked "Storage" and exit the door on the North wall. Face East and walk forward, stopping in the middle of the carpark. Turn NE and walk forward, you will see the broom and the dumpster on your right, near the stairs.

**Reward**

3x Lunchboxes

**Spring Cleaning: Collect 5 Soaps with the Abraxo Pip-Boy Skin equipped.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ec535fb504dd4566965f0525b39b5e0e~mv2.jpg)

**Locations:**

**Sutton Train Station** - 24

Fast Travel to Sutton Train Station. Follow the train tracks South. Continue to follow the train tracks for a while. You will see an NPC on the train tracks. Just after the NPC is a large white and red power pylon on your right. Turn and run over to the power pylon. The soap can be found in the bathtub, under the power pylon.

**Darling Sister's Lab** - 7

Fast Travel to Darling Sister's Lab. Kill the three Floaters that spawn first. Head to the building on the Eastern side of the area. Walk around the building in a circle until you see the red wheelbarrow with the soap inside.

**The Whitespring North Entrance/Whitesprings Mall** - 7

The Whitesprings Spa

3 can be found on the small table, on the right, in the front/waiting room.

1 can be found on the table, in the corridor behind the front/waiting room.

1 soap can be found in all three of the Suites, on the brown table, next to the T-Shirt and Slacks.

**Morgantown High School** - 6

Fast Travel to Morgantown High School and enter the building via the front door.

1 can be found downstairs in the female bathroom with the red tile floor (just before the Gym). Enter the bathroom and face East. Slowly walk forward while looking down. The soap is on the floor.

3 can be found downstairs in the male bathroom with the blue tile floor (just before the Gym). Enter the bathroom and walk West until you see the showers on your left. There are two soap on the floor of the shower and the third soap is in the locker just outside of the showers.

2 can be found upstairs in the Cooking Classroom. One soap is on the floor near the North wall and the other soap is on the bench near the South wall.

**Watoga Civic Center** - 6

Fast Travel to the Watoga Civic Center and enter the building.

Turn right, follow the corridor around and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Turn right, stick to the right-hand wall, and follow it around until you get to the shower area. There are four soaps on the floor of the shower as well as a rare baseball bat spawn.

From the showers above, face South and walk forward until you get to the terminal on the wall. Turn right and follow the corridor around until you are standing in the middle of the arena area. Face East and walk forward until you are at the top of the stairs. You should see a female bathroom sign to your right. Enter the female bathroom and the first soap can be found on the top of one of the sinks. The second soap can be found on the floor, on the other side of the female bathroom, near the wooden crate.

**Reward**

3x Legendary Modules

__Hive Paper__ - 2 Acid 

__Honey Beast Wing__ - 2 Acid

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f8cafc0aa3bc4db392178a368f4e5d76~mv2.jpg)

If it does not then:

**Locations:**

**Radioactive Pumpkin Seeds** - 4 Fertilizer

Daily: Trick or Treat Quest - turn in 10 Pumpkins and receive 10 Radioactive Pumpkin Seeds in return.

**Bag of Fertilizer** - 4 Fertilizer

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_50f910e88bc74a41a02e2638e3daaa64~mv2.jpg)

**Lewis & Sons** - 7 Bags

4 bags can be found in the Greenhouse.

3 can be found in the red wheelbarrow, near the Mr Handy tending the garden.

**Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center** - 5 Bags

2 bags can be found under a bench in the Western Greenhouse.

3 bags can be found on the ground, with a shovel, in the Eastern Greenhouse.

**Wixon Homestead** - 13 Bags

From the fast travel point, face West and run over to the white fence. Follow the white fence around (jump over the wire fence) until you get to a small ruined wooden shed at the back. The bags of fertilizer can be found inside the shed and around the edge of the shed.

**Pylon V-13 (Abandoned Bog Town)** - 8 Bags

From the fast travel point, turn NW and run over to the large brick building. Go up the stairs that are between the two brick buildings until you get to the top. At the top, face North and jump over to the metal tin roof. Look for the hole in the roof and drop down into the hut. You will land on top of the bags of fertilizer.

**NAR Repair Yard** - 11 Bags

From the fast travel point, turn SE and run over to the metal windmill and buildings in the distance.

1 bag can be found in the top trailer.

4 bags can be found in the Greenhouse.

3 bags can be found in the Southern trailer.

3 bags can be found in the Western trailer.

**Fort Defiance** - 5 Bags

5 bags can be found in the cemetery, behind and to the right of the gatehouse.

**Reward**

3x Perk Card Packs

**Spring Cleaning: Kill 1 Alien with the Cremator.**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_ea1f8e4fc4524714a11d9e775e8f445f~mv2.jpg)

The Spring Cleaning Challenge will be running during the last week of __Invaders from Beyond__. So bring your Cremator and get some tags on everything that moves.

You can find Alien __Random Encounters__ out in the wild while the Invaders from Beyond event is on the calendar. 

**Reward**

250 Score
